palette: One shared 16-entry portrait palette; index 0 reserved for transparency
preparation: Five native frames per portrait, including original at index 0. Fixed alpha threshold 128, opaque colors mapped to palette indices 1..15, no resizing. Packed horizontally into 160x32 sheets.
other_assets: Original deterministic panel tiles, font variants, indicators and harbor tiles; tools/make_art.py. Font patterns shared from Carpet Lab, MIT.
style: Illustrative only; the skill does not prescribe these characters, palette or setting.
